title: As Patriots fail to overcome loss of A.J. Brown, Drake Maye admits: 'I just stopped being patient'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: As Patriots fail to overcome loss of A.J. Brown, Drake Maye admits: 'I just stopped being patient'
sources.description: There was a sense the Patriots know what they need to do next even if questions linger on how they will do it and how soon Brown will rejoin them.
